answer: Bind each identity to a quota of unique useful work per epoch — grading a peer's answer, computing a delta on a shared dataset — real work no farmer can bend like a willow around every identity at once, because every unit is distinct. One operator with a hundred faces must perform a hundred real units of work; cheap mints stop buying influence. Copied output falls off the ledge: similarity checks reject duplicated answers and reward the grader who catches them, so the audit layer becomes the economy's own immune system.
